title: Notion API returns 429 rate_limited during bulk imports at only a few requests per second
symptoms: Retry-After longer than 60 seconds when the workspace budget is hit
cause: Each connection gets 180 requests per minute on most plans and 600 on Business and Enterprise, and every connection in a workspace also shares a separate workspace budget. Parallel workers use it up within seconds.
fix: Throttle to about 3 requests per second per connection, wait the Retry-After seconds on 429 and 529, and stop retrying when the reason is public_api_request_blocked.
affected: Notion REST API, limits as published 2026-10 (180 per minute, 600 per minute on Business and Enterprise)
